articles.summary: Zevia PBC (“Zevia”) (NYSE: ZVIA), the Company that provides naturally delicious, zero sugar better-for-you beverages, today announced that it plans to release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Zevia will also host a conference call to discuss its results at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. Investors and other interested parties may listen to the webcast of the conference call by logging on via the Investor Relations section of Zevia’s website at https://investors.zevia.com/ . Those who wish to participate in the call may do so by dialing (877) 423-9813 or (201) 689-8573 for international callers, conference ID 13762906. A replay of the webcast will be available for approximately thirty (30) days following the call at Zevia’s website at https://investors.zevia.com/. A copy of the earnings press release and supplemental financial disclosures will also be available on Zevia’s website at
articles.title: Zevia to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on November 4, 2026

articles.summary: Funds Strategic Reset to Drive Long-Term Value Creation Provides Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results Ahead of Previous Guidance Zevia PBC (“Zevia” or the “Company”) (NYSE:ZVIA), the Company that provides naturally delicious, zero sugar better-for-you beverages, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement with a fund managed by GP Investments Ltd. (collectively, “GP Investments”) to issue convertible preferred stock in exchange for $20 million of growth equity to fund key strategic priorities to drive meaningful long-term value creation for shareholders. The Company and its Board of Directors engaged Piper Sandler to thoroughly evaluate a broad range of strategic and financing alternatives over the past 12 months with a singular focus on maximizing shareholder value. Following a comprehensive review, Zevia’s management team and its Board of Directors determined that this growth equity investment represented the best path forward to accelerate shareholder value
articles.title: Zevia Announces $20 Million Growth Equity Investment
